'''Molavar''' was a backwater, [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], with a number of seedy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and low-income [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]]. It was inhabited by beings of various species, but especially by the native [[Molavaran]] race. [[Darca Nyl]] chased [[Lycan]] to the planet. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet lay within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
